title: Construction of a translational whole-body physiologically based pharmacokinetic model to investigate the biodistribution of lipid nanoparticle-based mRNA therapeutics for intracellular protein targets.
caption: Bar plot of mRNA and protein biodistribution Following IV Administration of 2 mg/kg mRNA-LNP in Rats. ( A ) Biodistribution of mRNA at t = 10 min at different tissue locations computed as percent injected dose. ( B ) Biodistribution of mRNA at 1 h time point at different tissues given as the percent of injected dose. ( C ) Biodistribution of protein, expressed as tissue-specific protein Cmax relative to liver protein Cmax
